51 -> 0. **`mypy` is clean over all six measured packages**: `Success: no issues found in 551 source files`. `odoo.orm`, `odoo.db`, `odoo.modules` and `odoo.service` were already there; this is `odoo.http` 26 and `odoo.libs` 25.

EIGHTEEN OF THE 26 ARE ONE MISSING TYPE, and the protocol carrying it was already
written. `HttpExtension` in `odoo/http/_protocols.py` declares the whole `ir.http`
dispatch surface and `test_ir_http_contract` compares it against the real model
hook by hook, but nothing carried it to the call sites: `Registry.__getitem__` is
`str -> type[BaseModel]`, so `registry["ir.http"]._match` and the thirteen reads
like it were unchecked attribute access on `BaseModel`.

Neither container can carry the type. The per-model `Literal` overloads on
`Environment.__getitem__` reach only protocols `odoo/orm` owns, and
`HttpExtension` is not one and must not become one -- `orm` may not import `http`.
The type comes from an accessor beside the protocol, `ir_http(registry | env)`,
and one return type serves both spellings because every hook on `ir.http` is a
`classmethod`: the two are the same bound callable, which is the surface the
protocol describes and the contract test measures.

The other eight of `odoo.http` are two `retrying(env=self.env)` calls passing
`Environment | None` where an `Environment` is required, and six in the test
package. `odoo.libs` is seven in production -- `set_expression` closure dicts
keyed `LeafIdType` rather than `int`, `working_on_database` trading an `object`
sentinel for a `was_set` bool, `Collector.update` running one chained loop
instead of two -- and eighteen behind them, EIGHT OF WHICH the `worker_thread`
fix cleared on its own, in `test_libs_contracts`, where every `thread.dbname`
read had been resolving against `threading.Thread` and not `WorkerThread`.

TWO GATES READ THE CALL SHAPE and the refactor moved both; see the commit message
for the accounting. `model_member_surface_check` reported all thirteen `ir.http`
members as REMOVED because it matches `container["model"].member` and the model
name had moved into a callee; both surface gates now look through the accessor.
`module.md`s tier table counts the same imports and goes 22 -> 27 per statement,
49 -> 56 per symbol.

Measured per section 9.3 -- fresh venv, mypy==2.3.0 alone, --no-incremental, over a
`git archive HEAD` tree carrying only this change. The same procedure measures the
committed a7ad377f4df at 51, so the floor this replaces was true of the tree that
banked it.
